name: juliet
description: Claude Code tooling for Juliet (avegancafe/Juliet), the scripted macOS + Fedora setup: the noelle agent ("I'm changing my computer config") and the skills it preloads — juliet-config, juliet-extension, juliet-cross-platform, juliet-bootstrap-step, add-app-config and add-fish-alias. Shared baseline for anyone running Juliet; personal tooling lives in other plugins.
